TC-11/S28.title: Timeline windows come from the retention config, not hard-coded values
TC-11/S28.detail: D6 re-check: STILL (pending Q15). Neither display window reads a retention config: the Hospital timeline keeps today's and yesterday's labels (convex/lib/courseTimeline.ts:15-21 isRecentCourseLine, called from src/features/rounding/patient/panels/HospitalCoursePanel.tsx:37), the Nursing Home card shows SHOW_LAST = 3 (src/features/snf/patient/panels/CoursePanel.tsx:12), and the windows are constants in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION). Stated: UAT 3.6 'All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded'.
